**Daily Devotional**

**January 18**

*24 Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only. (James 2:24 KJV)*

This verse at first looks like it is just opposite to what Paul was preaching, as Paul preached Grace, and that you are saved by faith in the Grace of God brought to us by Jesus (Ephesians 2:8). But if you take this in context you see that James is telling us that we are not saved by faith alone, as true saving faith is never alone. If you truly have faith to be born again, you will then want to do works of love, as you will love Jesus so much that you will do as He said. Jesus told us that if we love Him we would do as He commanded us (John 14:15), and we must do so to insure our salvation (Hebrews 5:9).

You have to keep in mind there are two kinds of works. Works of the Law are those things you do to try and gain your righteousness by what you do, thereby you are working to obtain right standing with God by your actions. Works of love or faith are many times the same things as works of the law. But you are not doing them to gain anything from God, but only doing them because of what Jesus has done for us, not because you have to, but because you want to serve Him who gave Himself for you. It is all in your heart motivation as to why you are doing what you are doing for the Lord, as He looks upon the heart (1 Samuel 16:7). Be sure you are working for the Lord out of love for Him and not out of trying to earn something from Him. Thank you Father for your Words.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
